            PRESIDENT, MPP., D. HIREHAL.
                [G.O.Ms.No.96, Panchayat Raj & Rural Development (Mandal.II),
                                                  3rd October, 2018.]
                           NOTIFICATION
            Whereas, a motion expressing no confidence against Smt. Palthuru
        Pushpavathi, President, Mandal Praja Parishad, D. Hirehal Mandal, Ananthapuramu
         District was moved under sub-section  (1]  of Section 245  of the Andhra
        Pradesh Panchayat Raj Act, 1994 (Andhra Pradesh Act 13 of 1994) ;
          2.    And whereas, a special meeting for the purpose of considering the above
        motion was held on 27.08.2018 ;
          3.   And whereas, when the said motion was put to vote,  it was supported
       by the nine (9) Members who were present out of total number of thirteen (13)
      Members of the Mandal Praja Parishad and thus the motion was passed
         with requisite majority ;
          4.    Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (2)
         of  Section  245  of  the Andhra  Pradesh  Panchayat  Raj  Act,1994,  the
       Government hereby remove Smt. Palthuru Pushpavathi, from  the  office
         of the President, Mandal Praja Parishad, D. Hirehal Mandal, Ananthapuramu
           District with immediate effect.
                                                   Dr. K.S. JAWAHAR REDDY,

                            NOTIFICATION

             Whereas, the term of the Special Officer of Srikakulam Municipal Corporation
       expired by 11.10.2018. And whereas, Government is of the opinion that ordinary elections to
       the above Urban Local Bodies could not be held in accordance with the provisions of the
      Andhra Pradesh Municipalities Act, 1965, the Visakhapatnam Municipal Corporations Act,
      1981, the Andhra Pradesh Municipal Corporations Act, 1994 due to prevailing situation in
       the light of bifurcation of A.P. State and also due to pending Court Cases in respect of
      Srikakulam Municipal Corporation.

       of section 62-A of the Andhra Pradesh Municipalities Act, 1965, and sections 14 and 17 of
       the Andhra Pradesh Municipal Corporation Act, 1994, read with section 70 G of Greater
      Hyderabad Municipal Corporation Act, 1955, the Governor of Andhra Pradesh hereby
       extends the term of the Special Officer of the Srikakulam Municipal Corporation for a further
       period 6 months from 11.10.2018 or till the elected body comes into office whichever is
        earlier.

                               SCHEDULE
             (A)    Plot Allotment Policy for the Land owners given their Lands to the Gannavaram Airport
                Development Land Pooling Scheme
               As per Rule 9(iii) of the Gannavaram Airport Development Land Pooling Scheme
                  (Formation & Implementation) Rules, 2015, the Authority shall guarantee the return
                    of reconstituted land/plots to the land owners who have surrendered the lands under
                Land Pooling Scheme. As per Rule 9(iii) read with 11(2) the Authority is responsible to
                  provide reconstituted plots in Capital City area. The reconstituted plots shall be
                   provided in Capital City area to a land owner having original plots in different areas in
                Gannavaram Airport Development Land Pooling Scheme area and also to provide
                     reconstituted plots within Capital City area to different land  owners requesting for
                        joint allocation as per the category of original land as per feasibility and availability of land.

   THE FUGITIVE ECONOMIC OFFENDERS ORDINANCE, 2018

                         NO. 1 OF 2018

       Promulgated by the President in the Sixty-ninth Year of the
                            Republic of India.

An Ordinance to provide for measures to deter fugitive economic offenders from evading the
      process of law in India by staying outside the jurisdiction of Indian courts, to preserve
      the sanctity of the rule of law in India and for matters connected therewith or incidental
      thereto.

WHEREAS the Fugitive Economic Offenders Bill, 2018 was introduced on the 12th day of
     March, 2018 in the House of the People;

AND WHEREAS the said Bill could not be taken up for consideration and passing in the House
      of the People;

AND WHEREAS Parliament is not in session and the President is satisfied that circumstances
      exist which render it necessary for him to take immediate action;

NOW, THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by clause (1) of article 123 of the
      Constitution, the President is pleased to promulgate the following Ordinance:—

                         CHAPTER I

                                   PRELIMINARY

      1. (1) This Ordinance may be called the Fugitive Economic Offenders Ordinance, 2018.   Short title,
                                                                                                          extent and
                                                                                                   commencement.
